sources.used_for: WAL-reset affected/fixed upstream versions; WAL commit distinct from checkpoint; no cross-file ATTACH atomicity in WAL.
EXTRA adds directory sync for DELETE commit; FULL rollback durability depends on filesystem.
Atomic rollback-journal transactions depend on locking and truthful flush/storage assumptions.
BEGIN IMMEDIATE, single writer, BUSY/COMMIT/error handling.
Separate connection isolation, serialised writes, avoid shared-cache/read-uncommitted.
Preserve hot journals; raw copying, filesystem and sync failures are outside simple process-crash claims.
Connection and page-count limits can be lowered for untrusted input/resource admission.
Explicit SQL transactions under autocommit=True; connection methods commit/rollback have no effect in that mode.
